name: Moon Cosmos
gauge: Gauge is not critical; use a firm tension so the centre is textured and the petals hold their slender shape.

steps.label: Rnd 1
steps.text: With centre yarn, work 8 sc in an MR; sl st in first sc to join.

steps.label: Rnd 2
steps.text: ch 1, puff in each sc around; sl st in first puff to join.

steps.label: Rnd 3
steps.text: Join petal yarn with a sl st in any sp between puffs. Work ch 8, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in each of next 4 ch, hdc in last ch, sl st in the same sp, sl st in next sp. Rep this sequence in the next sp 6 times. Work ch 8, sc in 2nd ch from hook, hdc in next ch, dc in each of next 4 ch, hdc in last ch, sl st in the same sp, then sl st in the first sp.

finishing: Fasten off both yarns securely after completing the flower.
Weave in all yarn tails on the reverse side without pulling the centre out of shape.
Lightly mist-block the flower, pinning the eight petals into an open, dancing shape. Let it dry completely before use.
notes: puff: yo, insert hook in the indicated st, yo and pull up a loop; rep this two more times, yo and pull through all 7 loops on hook.
The eight petals are worked around the centre spaces in the final round.
